name: Samsung Q80A
summary: The Q80A is the TV Vetro is developed on. Published Q80A records cover launcher behavior, root-agent startup and signed self-updates. Some 0.5.0 features, including Restore the TV, still lack a recorded manual TV test.

name: Samsung Q70A
summary: A community report with a diagnostic export showing the app, the service and the root agent running.

name: Samsung Q60A
summary: Reported working. The reporter changed the listen port to avoid a clash with tizen-youtube, which also listens on a default port.

name: Samsung QN85A
summary: Reported working, and back after a reboot. This report came without a numbered issue.

name: Samsung AU7000
status: Dashboard works; root agent did not connect
summary: Service and dashboard reported working; the root agent did not connect (the Host PC IP step was not confirmed), so the features that need it stay off.

name: Samsung Q67B
summary: Reported working on firmware 1720.7, the same firmware family as several other 2022 reports.

name: Samsung UE65BU8002
summary: Reported working. The Launcher needed the 0.3.1 fix for the Home cache folder before it started on this TV.

name: Samsung QE75QN85B
summary: Core functions were reported working. The Launcher failed before 0.3.1 because of the Home cache folder.

name: Samsung QN55S95B
summary: Reported working on a US-market QD-OLED model.

name: Samsung The Frame LS03B
summary: Reported working. The service started by itself after a cold boot. The Launcher was not tried on this TV.

name: Samsung Q65S95C
summary: Reported working on a 2023 QD-OLED model.

name: Samsung S90C
summary: Reported working on Tizen 7.0.

name: Samsung GU75CU7179
summary: Reported working on Tizen 9.0, installed with Apps2Samsung. A 2023 TV reported on Tizen 9.0 shows why model year alone does not tell you the installed Tizen version.

name: Samsung QN55Q65D
summary: Reported working, installed with Apps2Samsung.

name: Samsung S90D
summary: Reported working on Tizen 9, with the root agent back after a full restart (the owner's account).

name: Samsung Smart Monitor M8
summary: Installed, with the service and root agent running. What works beyond that has not been reported yet.
description: Samsung Smart Monitor M8 with Vetro: service and root agent reported running on firmware T-PTMWWC-1720.7. Feature testing and Tizen version were not reported.

name: Samsung TU7090
summary: Dashboard, app list and diagnostics reported working; features that need root access are unavailable.

name: Samsung T4300
summary: Dashboard, app list and diagnostics reported working; features that need root access are unavailable.

name: Samsung Q80R
summary: Works only with local changes, not with the stock package: a personal port with its own launcher host, app registry paths and Node.js 16.20.2. It was not reviewed or merged.

name: Samsung UE43NU7090
summary: Dashboard, app list and diagnostics reported working; features that need root access are unavailable.
